skill.effect: The creature's distinctive four-limbed skeleton stands out sharply among the native three-legged locals, making foreign body shapes instantly recognizable. You can quickly tell them apart by their physical structure.

chains.weakness: High center of mass makes it vulnerable to lateral strikes under 1.22 g.

journal.en: A four-legged ghost in a tripedal world. Gravity demands three. It brought four from Earth.

analogues.organism: Earth therizinosaurids and other graviportal tetrapods under elevated load — quadrupedal support scales with g up to ~1.25g without requiring tripedaly (elephant, sauropod limb mechanics per Biewener)

skill.effect: The creature's rake-like claws tear through the loose soil, revealing hidden underground water and symbiotic microbes. This vigorous digging leaves you feeling refreshed and ready for a short while.

chains.weakness: Inefficient bipedal/tripedal transition on native terrain; high caloric demand due to dense calcium bones.

journal.en: A four-legged ghost in a tripedal world. It dug for water, but the ground itself was built differently.

plausibility.summary: Specify claws work on Qu-disturbed spoil and furrows, not native copper-chitin substrates; stamina boost should come from exposed symbiont patches (F15), not from breaking native lattice ‘rock-soil’.
